name: Bisya
source:
Student council auditor; Sika deer

An auditor sent out by the student council to investigate alleged illegal activities being carried out at the lab. A sincere sort of Therio.

A member of the student council who somehow wrestles control of the Therio university students who won't cooperate. At times, this even includes the most sincere and commonsensical of the bunch.
